description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for importing book data from LibraryThing, with fields for title, author, publication year, and ISBN, utilizing Jackson annotations for JSON serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: LibraryThingBookImport
classes.description: A Java class representing the structure of a book imported from LibraryThing, with annotated fields for JSON mapping, including constructors, getters, and setters generated by Lombok.
